title: Pair with Given Sum in Sorted Rotated Array

content.problemStatement:
Given an array that is sorted and then rotated around an unknown point. Find if the array has a pair with a given sum 'k'.

Note: It may be assumed that all elements in the array are distinct.

Example:

Input: arr[]={11,15,6,8,9,10},k=16

Output: yes

There is a pair (6,10)with sum 16
content.inputFormat:
The input has the size and elements of the array.

The last row has the sum value.

solution.approach: Find if there exists a pair with sum K in a sorted and rotated array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    k = int(toks[n+1])
    st = set(arr)
    found = any((k - x) in st and (k - x) != x for x in arr)
    print("Yes" if found else "No")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Use hash set to check if K - x exists in array with distinct index.
